pictures.author: Saddam Hussain Ansari (Saddam19)
pictures.observations: Whole vertical standing rebuilt tower: pale tapered mostly blind shaft, strong horizontal collars, sparse small circular oculi; projecting circular observation balcony/open rail, rounded crown and slender finial. Small arched entrance at the base. Preserved older stump under a transparent pyramidal shelter in front/left.

pictures.author: Saddam Hussain Ansari (Saddam19)
pictures.observations: Whole landscape 960x720 standing view: eight main illuminated shaft collars, sparse staggered oculi, stone stepped footing, narrow low arched entrance on pictured right. Projecting molded balcony, open metal rail and shallow rounded dome/needle. Separate glass pyramid reveals the older brown masonry at lower left. Night lighting is reference context, not the daytime material color.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing rebuilt Dharahara: pale tapered circular shaft with eight molded collars/sparse circular oculi, actual recessed arched base entrance/closed dark door, projecting molded observation deck/open balustrade, shallow domed lantern and slender finial. Separate mapped stepped old base, irregular broken brick/plaster stump under an open-framed translucent pyramidal shelter. Original simple trim/rail/radial support vocabulary, shared textures and four browser levels. No reconstruction of the destroyed full historical tower, copied inscription/photo atlas, furnished interior, underground museum, broad precinct plaza or temporary lights/visitors.
